🇮🇷❌🇺🇸🇮🇱 A video clip circulating during the 40-day war shows personnel from Iranian missile units fueling medium-range ballistic missiles (MRBMs) prior to launch.
The Qader family of missiles utilizes liquid fuel; the clip likely depicts the fueling process using Red Fuming Nitric Acid (RFNA)—a highly reactive and toxic liquid oxidizer—carried out within the tunnels of Iran's "missile cities." The advantage of liquid fuel is that it allows for relatively long-term storage, unlike propellants that must be loaded immediately before launch.

🇾🇪❌🇾🇪 — Yemeni government forces captured dozens of Houthi fighters during clashes in Al-Jarahi district in southern Al Hudaydah, according to a government official cited by Anadolu Agency.
➡️ Fayyad al-Numan, assistant undersecretary at Yemen's Information Ministry, said government forces had captured "dozens of members of the terrorist Houthi militia." Activists posted images on social media purportedly showing Houthi captives held by government forces. The Houthis had not commented by 1400 GMT.
➡️ The clashes come amid a military escalation across several fronts in Yemen following reciprocal attacks that began in July, ending a period of relative calm that had held under a UN-brokered truce since April 2022. Earlier Saturday, government-aligned National Resistance Forces said they shot down two Houthi attack drones in Taiz province. The Houthis have controlled the capital Sanaa and several other cities since September 2014.
⭐️ Follow
